newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers dip late, Med also falls.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers dip late, Med also falls.

text.p: ARA bunker prices dipped late on Friday as one trading house hauled the barge market down, while the Mediterranean dropped more simply, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST traded at around $87 fob with the barge market stable at $86 fob ARA all morning. However, in the afternoon, one player sold three barge lots at $82, bringing bunker quotes notionally down to $84 delivered.
The market recovered later on, leaving bunkers about $1 a tonne lower than on Thursday, at $86 fob.
Total ARA demand was low, below 10,000 tonnes, although there was one enquiry of over 3,000 tonnes.
Hamburg prices were little changed, in line with Rotterdam's languid morning. However, there were fewer discounts available. Business was slack.
Mediterranean prices dropped on average some $3 a tonne, as benchmark quotes fell. Most ports reported little business, although no lower than a typical Friday.
Egyptian fuel oil bunkers fell by around $4 a tonne. Port Said was still dry and Alexandria deliveries subject to enquiries.
